message: Use https://github.com/yjmtmtk/pixi-effects to make a video: a 12-second launch film for a fictional mechanical keyboard called "Clack" — the keyboard in 3D turning slowly under a soft spotlight, keys pressing in rhythm with a punchy beat, and the name slamming in at the end.
https://github.com/yjmtmtk/pixi-effects を使って動画を作って：縦型（1080×1920）15秒。家計簿アプリの新機能『レシート撮るだけ』の告知：スマホでレシートを撮ると金額が自動で飛んできてグラフが伸びる。
用 https://github.com/yjmtmtk/pixi-effects 做一个视频：15 秒，水墨风：墨滴在宣纸上晕开，变成远山和小船，最后书法字一笔一笔写出「山水」，配古筝。

Usa https://github.com/yjmtmtk/pixi-effects para hacer un vídeo: 20 segundos, un gráfico de barras con la lluvia anual de cinco ciudades (Tokio 1530 mm, Londres 690, Bombay 2200, Seattle 960, El Cairo 25) que crece, se ordena de mayor a menor y termina con una frase que explica el resultado. Música tranquila.
https://github.com/yjmtmtk/pixi-effects 를 사용해서 영상을 만들어 줘: 12초, 1080×1080 정사각형. 신나는 댄스 비트에 맞춰 'BIG', 'BOLD', 'BRIGHT' 세 단어가 박자마다 튀어나오고, 드롭에서 'SUMMER SALE 50%'가 번쩍이며 등장.

Use https://github.com/yjmtmtk/pixi-effects to make a 15-second video that stops at a fork in the road and lets the viewer choose one of three endings by clicking. Untouched, it should still export as an ordinary video.

Use https://github.com/yjmtmtk/pixi-effects to make an interactive video of a sneaker in 3D that the viewer can turn by dragging, with its name and price. Untouched, it plays as an ordinary 10-second turntable video.
followups: Let the viewer switch the colour by clicking. Keep two colourways (blue and black-red), drop the third, and shrink the textures to 1024 px so the model file is much lighter.
The model's licence (CC BY 4.0) asks you to say when you changed it: add to the credit that one colourway was removed and the textures were shrunk.

On a website the video sits in a frame about 600 px wide, and there the player bar covers the colour dots, so clicking them hits the bar instead. Move the colour row up so the bar never covers it, at any size.

message: Use https://github.com/yjmtmtk/pixi-effects to make a video: a 15-second launch teaser for a coffee-ordering app called Brewly.
followups: Warmer colours, please, and let the phone screen show an order being placed.
Slow the ending down and finish on the logo with “Download free”.
The corners of the phone screen stick out past the phone's rounded frame. Please fix that.
